Welcome to Chicken Rice Shop!

🍗 Cook chicken rice by hand for your customers
💰 Earn cash and tips for every dish
🥚 Hatch eggs and raise rare chickens
🏠 Upgrade your street stall into a big shophouse
🤝 Hire cooks and waiters to keep the cash flowing
🍜 Unlock noodles, roast chicken and shaved ice
⭐ Serve rich customers and food critics for huge pay!
